## What

Adds a retry with backoff to the sync job.

## Why

Sync runs fail on timeouts and nobody notices.

## File risk

### 🔴 Critical

### 🟡 Medium

- `src/sync/job.ts` — retry with backoff on timeout

### 🟢 Low

- `package-lock.json` — lockfile refreshed, no `package.json` change
- `src/sync/job.test.ts` — covers the retry
- `README.md` — documents the retry setting
